title: Tupac Estate Demands Drake Remove 'Taylor Made Freestyle' Over AI Voice (Rolling Stone)
notes: Rolling Stone (top-tier), Jon Blistein, 2024-04-24. Tupac estate cease-and-desist to Drake over AI Tupac (and AI Snoop Dogg) vocals in 'Taylor Made Freestyle' (Kendrick beef); lawyer Howard King; 24-hr deadline; track only on social (not streaming); 1M+ streams; references 'Heart on My Sleeve' Drake/Weeknd clone.
